verdict.rationale: The core install tooling is an open-source CLI published on GitHub that runs locally. It pulls skills from any git source you control, including private repos, GitLab, Azure DevOps Server, direct URLs and local paths, so a user can run the workflow on self-owned infrastructure. Nothing shows that the skills.sh site itself (leaderboard, search, discovery service) can be self-hosted. Missing for 10: a self-hostable skills.sh directory/leaderboard/search backend, self-hosting documentation, independent corroboration of a fully self-hosted deployment.
